title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: amount still open on a late demurrage line
content:
## Scope

When a late demurrage invoice line of a per-container record under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category is cleared as not collectible, this rule fixes the amount still open on that line.

## Rule

The amount still open is the line's amount less every waiver and dispute credit already booked with the line as the invoice line they refer to, including waivers of the operations department. It is never taken below nothing.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Late demurrage line as invoiced | USD 1200.00 |
| Dispute credit of a decided dispute booked against the line | USD 300.00 |
| Operations department waiver booked against the line | USD 60.00 |
| Amount still open | USD 840.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Q: Does a waiver the operations department granted reduce the amount still open?**
A: Yes. Every waiver and dispute credit booked against the line counts, including those of the operations department.

**Q: Does a card payment on the record reduce it?**
A: No. Only waivers and dispute credits booked against the line are taken off.
